forecast.vintage: OBR Economic and fiscal outlook, October 2026, which policyengine-uk 2.165.1 ships as its own growth rates; src/uk_budget_data/forecast/obr_october_2026.json applies the dashboard's values from the same tables over them, and src/uk_budget_data/forecast sets current law's fuel duty path

calibration.source: the certified dataset pinned by the installed policyengine bundle: Microcosm UK from policyengine 6.10.1, policyengine-uk-data before it
calibration.vintage: as pinned by the installed bundle

notes: The forecast is the Budget's OBR forecast: every simulation, baseline and reform alike, is built on the October 2026 growth rates. policyengine-uk 2.165.1 ships them itself, and src/uk_budget_data/forecast/obr_october_2026.json sets the same values for CPI, RPI, CPIH, average earnings, rents, mortgage interest, non-labour income, council tax and the September CPI and May to July earnings gaps; its per-capita incomes, house prices, social rents and CPI after housing costs differ from the engine's by up to 0.3 points a year. Series that file does not list keep what the installed policyengine-uk ships, which is that forecast too; the receipt records the exact model version.
